items.text: Sail wind behavior is now fully server‑side, eliminating client/server mismatches and ensuring consistent wind effects on sailboats.

Livestock breeding rebalanced: bond time increased to 15 min, reproduction blocked until full bond, population capped at 300 per species, new "livestock.cullexcess" command to cull excess, and "livestock.breedOnlyAtHome" convar to restrict breeding near a player’s TC.
Cows no longer unfreeze their needs or age incorrectly when bonded, fixing livestock stat inconsistencies.
Halloween string lights are now deployable again.
Modded servers are now correctly tagged and will no longer crash before fully starting.
Water now correctly appears in underground and underwater lab areas, restoring expected water physics and visual cues.

2026-10-02.summary:
### Sailing

### Livestock & Animals
- Livestock breeding rebalanced: bond time increased to 15 min, reproduction blocked until full bond, population capped at 300 per species, new "livestock.cullexcess" command to cull excess, and "livestock.breedOnlyAtHome" convar to restrict breeding near a player’s TC.
- Cows no longer unfreeze their needs or age incorrectly when bonded, fixing livestock stat inconsistencies.

### Deployables
- Halloween string lights are now deployable again.

### World & Environment
- Water now correctly appears in underground and underwater lab areas, restoring expected water physics and visual cues.

items.text: Fixed continuous input failures caused by mis‑detected Steam input at startup.
Fixed gamepad cursor state handling.
Sleeping bag placement range guide now updates correctly when its configuration values change.
Pie menu now correctly updates option names and descriptions, removing stale placeholder text.

Improved livestock behavior: reduced clipping when leading multiple animals or at troughs, prevented attacks on players inside vehicles, fixed collisions with travelling vendors, resolved various bull and ram issues (head‑butting, charging glitches, animation errors), and stopped cows from sliding unexpectedly. Livestock also can no longer be damaged inside safe zones.
Jungle plants now receive proper groundwater, fixing the previous lack of water for terrain‑placed flora.
Fixed rifle orientation while sprinting and added sprint speed modifiers to specific rifles (med, jungle, diver AKs).
Minicrossbow now plays only the necessary reload animation during partial reloads in 3‑person mode.
Fixed a potential crash caused by a NullReferenceException in lock loading logic.
Corrected biofuel generator placement so it no longer snaps backwards when placed.
Added the electronic chessboard DLC, including split game model, chess and checkers pieces, and updated deployable prefab.
Water jugs are now classified as Items, restoring the ability to recycle them and allowing storage in fridges and minifridges.
The quick join menu now correctly refreshes, ensuring players see up‑to‑date server listings.

2026-10-01.summary:
### Input & UI

- Fixed gamepad cursor state handling.
- Sleeping bag placement range guide now updates correctly when its configuration values change.
- Pie menu now correctly updates option names and descriptions, removing stale placeholder text.

### Livestock & Animals
- Improved livestock behavior: reduced clipping when leading multiple animals or at troughs, prevented attacks on players inside vehicles, fixed collisions with travelling vendors, resolved various bull and ram issues (head‑butting, charging glitches, animation errors), and stopped cows from sliding unexpectedly. Livestock also can no longer be damaged inside safe zones.
- Jungle plants now receive proper groundwater, fixing the previous lack of water for terrain‑placed flora.

### Combat & Weapons
- Fixed rifle orientation while sprinting and added sprint speed modifiers to specific rifles (med, jungle, diver AKs).
- Minicrossbow now plays only the necessary reload animation during partial reloads in 3‑person mode.

- Fixed a potential crash caused by a NullReferenceException in lock loading logic.
- Corrected biofuel generator placement so it no longer snaps backwards when placed.

### DLC Content

### Quality of Life

items.text: Increased bread and brioche dung boost durations (now 6/10 minutes) and made animals prioritize troughs with boost food
Purchased animals now always spawn in front of the vendor instead of behind the player
Adjusted wool vendor stack limits: minimum 25, maximum 400; delivering 400 wool grants top rewards
Fixed unloadable train cars to apply the softcore loot multiplier and doubled loot amounts in train car containers
Added a countdown timer to the dome pump when the oil rig countdown is active
Fixed hole depth not being cleared correctly during hole passes
Implemented a map cursor with fixed center crosshairs and the ability to add/remove map markers at the cursor
Resolved loss of player teams, invites, and contacts after server crashes and introduced opt‑out for save‑cache usage on entities
Increased Milky Healing Tea healing amount to 112 (previously capped at 100)
Fixed a bug where the local client player could be destroyed during a scene switch and improved reloadmap stability.
Corrected an invalid isLoading state after reloading a map, restoring camera control.
Eliminated RustNavigation null‑reference errors on map reload and fixed a camera detachment issue.
Rebalanced livestock food consumption, reducing the amount of food required.
Added halters and leading ropes to all livestock (adult animals now have two ropes, halter models applied).
Improved vendor dialogues: now shows required wool amount when you lack wool, and calf purchase dialogue correctly reflects insufficient scrap.
Prevented wild livestock from dying due to hunger or unmet needs (health now floors at 50%).
Stopped wild livestock from being passively tamed, added taming decay when bond isn’t full, blocked sleepers from taming, and gave calves a modest familiarity bonus to curb uncontrolled breeding.
Boombox activation now counts toward team objective progress for teammates present in the same underwater lab.
Motorcycles and bicycles now dismount to the side instead of on top, fixing awkward dismount behavior.
Fixed a rare case where crates could duplicate in oil rig puzzle rooms after a server crash.
Resolved pooling bugs that caused crabs and jellyfish to frequently appear invisible.
Fixed issue where animals could not eat from troughs.
Bread and brioche dung boost durations increased to 6 and 10 minutes, and animals now prioritize eating from boosted troughs (fixed earlier trough‑eating issue).
Livestock feeding eased: food requirement reduced, wild animals no longer die of hunger (health capped at 50%), halters added to all livestock, and adult animals receive proper leading ropes.
Passive taming and uncontrolled breeding of wild livestock disabled; taming decay introduced for unbonded animals, sleepers blocked from passive taming, and calves gain a modest familiarity bonus.
Vendor now warns when you lack enough wool to sell, and calf purchase dialogue correctly checks for sufficient scrap.
Purchased animals now spawn in front of the vendor instead of behind the player.
Wool stack limits adjusted: minimum 25, maximum 400; delivering a full 400‑wool stack grants top‑tier rewards.
Milky Healing Tea now restores up to 112 health (capped at 100 pending health).
Lootable train cars now apply the softcore loot multiplier correctly and drop double the items.
Map cursor shows a fixed center crosshair and lets you add or remove markers at that point.
The pump at the dome displays a countdown timer when the oil rig countdown is active.
Player teams, invites, and contacts now persist correctly after server crashes; entities can opt out of the save cache.
Fixed crashes and camera issues during map reloads and scene switches, restoring player and camera stability.
Resolved rare crate duplication in oil‑rig puzzle rooms after crashes and restored visibility for crabs and jellyfish.
Motorcycles and bicycles now dismount to the side instead of the top, fixing mount point ordering.
Boombox activation now counts toward the underwater lab team objective for all members present.
Hole digging now correctly clears depth after a pass, preventing leftover terrain depth artifacts.
Entity scaling updates apply instantly across the network, so size changes (e.g., scaled deployables) are visible without leaving range.
Static fence gates render on the proper layer, fixing interaction issues where gates could be visually obstructed or unresponsive.
Medieval doors now correctly count as closed for base occlusion, restoring intended base protection.

2026-09-30.summary:

- Passive taming and uncontrolled breeding of wild livestock disabled; taming decay introduced for unbonded animals, sleepers blocked from passive taming, and calves gain a modest familiarity bonus.

### Economy & Healing

- Milky Healing Tea now restores up to 112 health (capped at 100 pending health).

### Exploration & Loot

### UI & Map Enhancements

- Resolved rare crate duplication in oil‑rig puzzle rooms after crashes and restored visibility for crabs and jellyfish.

### Mobility & Mission Tweaks
- Motorcycles and bicycles now dismount to the side instead of the top, fixing mount point ordering.
